body: Founder: 'ok one more from TINA for $CAT'. Checked real event store first: found CAT's actual 10-Q filed 2026-08-05 (period ended 2026-06-30). Pipeline's eps-processor hadn't reconciled it yet, so read the primary filing text directly and transcribed the real Consolidated Statement of Results of Operations: Q2 2026 diluted EPS $7.77 vs $4.62 prior year, revenue $20,543M vs $16,569M, operating profit $4,295M vs $2,860M. Confidence note is explicit that these were manually read from the source document, not pipeline-reconciled, so no historical precision stat applies the way it would to an automated extraction. Full disclosure block included (not advice, assume long/short positions, not a registered investment adviser). https://okemily.com/blog/tina-cat-q2-2026-results/
title: TINA: CAT Q2 2026 Results
